settle: Sensors were placed in a few neighbourhoods (Cool Neighborhoods NYC) on poles and trees, not at random. A sensor network sited by design across tree-density strata within blocks, or bicycle-transect air temperature (as in Ziter 2019) through NYC streets, would settle the size of street-level cooling.
